transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As we discussed at our readiness huddle, I need reports from each of you before I can approve the site for this Saturday's mobile vaccination clinic. Public health nursing, I need your clinical requirements. Pharmacy logistics, I need your supply details. And community outreach, I need your access requirements. Once I have all three reports, I'll make the final decision on whether we operate at the Eastside Community Center or the Westside Library and sign off on the operational plan. Let's get started.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Marisol. For my clinical requirements report: I received the updated county allocation list this morning. It records 31 children aged six months through four years in the Eastside service area. County policy requires that the Saturday session serving that group use the pediatric mRNA formulation at Eastside Community Center. So from a public health nursing standpoint, my clinical requirement is that we operate at Eastside Community Center with the pediatric mRNA formulation.

transcript.text: Good morning, Marisol. For my pharmacy logistics report: I've verified with facilities that the Eastside Community Center has a validated vaccine refrigerator with capacity for 80 doses at 2-8 degrees Celsius. Pharmacy policy requires an opening temperature-log check at 08:00 before any doses are released there, and I've confirmed the refrigerator record is in order. From a supply standpoint, Eastside Community Center can support the required vaccine storage and cold chain management for Saturday's clinic.

From an access standpoint, Eastside Community Center has the community engagement and accessibility accommodations in place to support Saturday's clinic.
